capabilities: Draw all 15 UML 2.x diagram types with dedicated shapes and connectors
Sketch freehand and convert strokes into recognized UML shapes
Build hierarchical digital logic schematics with chips, pins, and buses
Route edges with orthogonal obstacle avoidance, layers, grouping, and a minimap
Export diagrams to standalone SVG or chunked RAG-ready markdown and receive JSON patches from external AI agents
disambiguation: It saves its own .canvuspp files with UML semantics rather than editing core Obsidian Canvas boards, though files stay compatible with Canvas 1.0 viewers.
extras: Detailed patch-format documentation lives in docs/cli/PATCH-FORMAT.md rather than the README. The plugin advertises zero telemetry and no network requests. Installation via BRAT or manual download is described alongside the community plugin listing.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Canvas supports general node-and-edge boards but lacks formal UML notation, hierarchical hardware schematics, and shape recognition for modeling work.

relations.evidence: external AI coding agents (such as Google Antigravity) to safely inspect and patch diagrams

requires.name: Google Antigravity (or another AI CLI agent)

summary: Visual diagramming engine that renders all 15 UML 2.x diagram types, Logisim-style digital hardware schematics, and freehand sketches on an infinite canvas with AI agent patching.
